scene.label: Act 1, Scene 10
scene.title: SCENE X. The camp of the Volsces

content.text: A flourish. Cornets. Enter Tullus Aufidius, bloody, with two or three soldiers.

lines.text: The town is ta'en.
lines.plainText: The town is ta'en

lines.text: 'Twill be delivered back on good condition.
lines.plainText: 'Twill be delivered back on good condition

lines.text: Condition?
lines.plainText: Condition

lines.text: I would I were a Roman, for I cannot,
lines.plainText: I would I were a Roman for I cannot

lines.text: Being a Volsce, be that I am. Condition?
lines.plainText: Being a Volsce be that I am Condition

lines.text: What good condition can a treaty find
lines.plainText: What good condition can a treaty find

lines.text: I' th' part that is at mercy? Five times, Martius,
lines.plainText: I' th' part that is at mercy Five times Martius

lines.text: I have fought with thee; so often hast thou beat me
lines.plainText: I have fought with thee so often hast thou beat me

lines.text: And wouldst do so, I think, should we encounter
lines.plainText: And wouldst do so I think should we encounter

lines.text: As often as we eat. By th' elements,
lines.plainText: As often as we eat By th' elements

lines.text: If e'er again I meet him beard to beard,
lines.plainText: If e'er again I meet him beard to beard

lines.text: He's mine or I am his. Mine emulation
lines.plainText: He's mine or I am his Mine emulation

lines.text: Hath not that honour in't it had; for where
lines.plainText: Hath not that honour in't it had for where

lines.text: I thought to crush him in an equal force,
lines.plainText: I thought to crush him in an equal force

lines.text: True sword to sword, I'll potch at him some way,
lines.plainText: True sword to sword I'll potch at him some way

lines.text: Or wrath or craft may get him.
lines.plainText: Or wrath or craft may get him

lines.text: He's the devil.
lines.plainText: He's the devil

lines.text: Bolder, though not so subtle. My valour's poisoned
lines.plainText: Bolder though not so subtle My valour's poisoned

lines.text: With only suff'ring stain by him; for him
lines.plainText: With only suff'ring stain by him for him

lines.text: Shall fly out of itself. Nor sleep nor sanctuary,
lines.plainText: Shall fly out of itself Nor sleep nor sanctuary

lines.text: Being naked, sick, nor fane nor Capitol,
lines.plainText: Being naked sick nor fane nor Capitol

lines.text: The prayers of priests nor times of sacrifice,
lines.plainText: The prayers of priests nor times of sacrifice

lines.text: Embarquements all of fury, shall lift up
lines.plainText: Embarquements all of fury shall lift up

lines.text: Their rotten privilege and custom 'gainst
lines.plainText: Their rotten privilege and custom 'gainst

lines.text: My hate to Martius. Where I find him, were it
lines.plainText: My hate to Martius Where I find him were it

lines.text: At home, upon my brother's guard, even there,
lines.plainText: At home upon my brother's guard even there

lines.text: Against the hospitable canon, would I
lines.plainText: Against the hospitable canon would I

lines.text: Wash my fierce hand in's heart. Go you to th' city;
lines.plainText: Wash my fierce hand in's heart Go you to th' city

lines.text: Learn how 'tis held and what they are that must
lines.plainText: Learn how 'tis held and what they are that must

lines.text: Be hostages for Rome.
lines.plainText: Be hostages for Rome

lines.text: Will not you go?
lines.plainText: Will not you go

lines.text: I am attended at the cypress grove. I pray you—
lines.plainText: I am attended at the cypress grove I pray you

lines.text: 'Tis south the city mills,—bring me word thither
lines.plainText: 'Tis south the city millsbring me word thither

lines.text: How the world goes, that to the pace of it
lines.plainText: How the world goes that to the pace of it

lines.text: I may spur on my journey.
lines.plainText: I may spur on my journey

lines.text: I shall, sir.
lines.plainText: I shall sir
